title: Extraction of protein from oilseed meal residues of sesame, hazelnut, almond and pumpkin produced in the oil industry for application in human and animal food
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25141-25149
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07720B, Paper
Open Access

Narges Rahemizadeh, Ali Gholami
This study presents the current knowledge on the protein and amino acid composition of common oilseed meals and the nutrition, health benefits and food applications of oilseed meals containing sesame, hazelnut, almond, and pumpkin.
